source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-21 by exhaustive search with no input array and no random numbers. The group Z3 x Z3 permutes 18 of the 20 rows in two regular orbits of 9 rows and fixes the other 2 rows (programs/mkgrp.py z3z3 0,0 2). The program programs/orbq7.c lists every ternary column whose 9 images under the group are pairwise qualitatively independent (6,513,921 column orbits among 572,838,885 candidate columns), joins two orbits when all their columns are pairwise qualitatively independent, and searches for every set of 7 mutually joined orbits up to the normaliser of the group (5,184 representatives). The full search was run in two halves (commands orbq7 z_20_00_f2.txt 7 0 w20 2 0 and orbq7 z_20_00_f2.txt 7 0 w20b 2 1) and both ran to completion. It finds 5 sets of 7 orbits, all at representative 2610, and each is a 20 x 63 covering array. The array is the first set. No further column is qualitatively independent of all 63 columns. programs/recipe_20at63.sh repeats the search at representative 2610 (command orbq7 z_20_00_f2.txt 7 0 w20 5184 2610), wrote programs/RECIPE_build.log, and gives the identical file. Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
construction: Array invariant under Z3 x Z3 acting on the 20 rows in two regular orbits of 9 and two fixed rows: seven column orbits of length 9, found by exhaustive search
notes: 20 rows at 63 columns, the cited size; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start; no input array; the search program orbq7.c was written by an AI model for this project
